# vendors/

The AI providers are the `provider` entries in `aibom_inventory` in the
[manifest](../systems/ura-ai-chatbot/manifest.yaml): Sunbird AI, Cloudflare
Workers AI and Google AI Studio. The manifest is the list. This README does not
repeat it.

| Slot | State | Artifact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contract | Missing | The repository records no contract or AI-specific terms for any provider. |
| Data flows | Elsewhere | The cross-border row in [privacy_controls.md](../systems/ura-ai-chatbot/privacy_controls.md) and the [DPIA](../systems/ura-ai-chatbot/dpia.md) say which processors receive data. [threagile.yaml](../../docs/security/threat-model/threagile.yaml) models the data flows. |
| Breach notification | Missing | No provider's duty to notify a breach is recorded. The project's own notice to taxpayers is section 1.7 of the [privacy notice](../../docs/capstone/week04-privacy-and-aup.md). |
